# DM-AHR-ViT: diffusion hair removal and ViT classification on HAM10000

**Research prototype only. Not clinically validated and not intended for diagnosis, triage or patient care.** Generated by `scripts/82_final_status.py` from artifacts; every number is read from a file under `artifacts/`.

> produced with a hair detector whose held-out image specificity was 0.038. That detector has

> re-evaluated. The v2 results — including a null classification result and a negative result

> `reports/real_hair_validation/audit_v2_integration.md` and the CSVs in
> `reports/real_hair_validation/v2/`. This report is retained unchanged for provenance;
> do not cite its hair-condition numbers as current.

Seed counts differ by arm: A, A*, B, Cv2 are pooled over eight seeds (42, 123, 2026, 7, 11, 17, 23, 31); Creleased, C are evaluated over the three pre-registered seeds (42, 123, 2026), so three-seed numbers appear only for those two arms and are labelled as such.

## Final status (generated by `scripts/82_final_status.py`; do not edit by hand)

Research prototype only. Not clinically validated and not intended for diagnosis or patient care.

### 1. Diffusion root cause and reproduction

- Root cause of the first diffusion run's failure: inverted noise-level encoding in the trainer (decision D25); the repaired trainer is covered by contract tests.
- DERMAHAIR (707 public pairs; Hugging Face and Kaggle copies are byte-identical): do-nothing floor 18.82 dB / SSIM 0.5698 / LPIPS 0.5740; paper 41.04 dB / 0.9656.
- released, 10 strided steps: PSNR 22.48 dB, SSIM 0.3639, LPIPS 0.4399; verdict **not reproduced**.
- released, 2,000 steps: PSNR 35.24 dB, SSIM 0.9175, LPIPS 0.0683; verdict **not reproduced**.

## Hypothesis verdicts (computed by rule from the numbers above)

- **H1, image quality: not supported.** Cv2 minus DullRazor on the held-out synthetic pairs: -6.56 dB PSNR (-6.91 to -6.17), -0.057 SSIM (-0.065 to -0.050). Synthetic hair only.
- **H2, classification: not supported.** A minus B +0.048 (Holm p 0.008); Cv2 minus the 128 px control -0.006 (-0.034 to +0.021).
- **H3, explainability: inconclusive (all between-arm rows struck).** Against the resolution-matched control (Cv2 minus A*, corrected frame) the recall difference is rollout +0.002 (-0.016 to +0.022); 10 of 10 between-arm recall rows are struck by the seed-spread rule. A fixed centred Gaussian reaches recall 0.468 (A, B) and 0.544 (128 px arms) because lesions are large (mean mask area 0.455 and 0.374 of the model frame) and central (94.9% of masks contain the image centre).

## Limitations and failure cases

- Image-quality evidence uses synthetic hair on clean photographs; real-hair removal quality is not validated.
- Our first diffusion run (arm C) failed because of a trainer defect (inverted noise-level encoding); it is kept as a recorded failure.
- The released diffusion checkpoint did not reproduce the published image-quality figure on the public DERMAHAIR pairs; the matching effort stopped by the pre-stated rule and no diffusion model was trained on DERMAHAIR.
- The diffusion models work at 128 px, the classifier at 224 px; seeds are eight (three for C and Creleased); the minimum detectable macro-F1 difference is about 0.04 to 0.05.
- Lesion masks are single-rater (Tschandl et al., Nature Medicine 2020) and large and central, which limits localisation metrics.
- The corrected explanation analysis re-scored the same test images after the geometry fix (decision D40).
